knowledge.plain_language_summary: A double-sided internally lit 12in-deep extruded aluminum push-through cabinet monument with a layered aluminum-angle/skin stepped-accent body, saddle-mounted to a 5x5 HSS steel pole in a direct-burial concrete footing.
knowledge.rationale: Push-through logo with a diffuser film gives an even halo; a single welded-saddle steel pole carries the cabinet on an engineered footing.

structure.construction: double-sided 12in deep extruded aluminum, 2in retainers, 1/8in faces; logo 3/4in clear acrylic push-thru (1/2in returns) with vinyl + 60% white diffuser film 2nd-surface; saddle-mounted to pole via 2x2x1/4in aluminum angle saddles
1.5x1.5x1/8in aluminum angle frame + 0.090in skin (stepped accent); 5x5x1/4in HSS steel pole; 3500psi direct-burial concrete footing

materials_manifest.product: Matthews MP07026 Stormy Sky / MP32071 White Wonder / MP02110 Cook Islands Blue

craft_observations: Diffuser film behind push-through for even halo; engineered single-pole footing.
